Bash(bash -c '
set -e
echo "=== 装的 vim/gvim ==="
pacman -Q | grep -iE "^\(vim|gvim|neovim\) " || true
echo

rm -f /tmp/nc.* /tmp/vc.* /tmp/ncfg.*
for i in 1 2 3; do vim  -u NONE -N --noplugin --startuptime /tmp/vc.$i  +qa >/dev/null 2>&1; done
for i in 1 2 3; do nvim --clean               --startuptime /tmp/nc.$i  +qa >/dev/null 2>&1; done
for i in 1 2 3; do nvim                       --startuptime /tmp/ncfg.$i +qa >/dev/null 2>&1; done

echo "vim  裸启动\(-u NONE\):           $\(grep -h " total" /tmp/vc.*  | awk "{print \\$1}" | tr "\\n" " " | sed "s/ /ms  /g"\)"
echo "nvim 裸启动\(--clean\):           $\(grep -h " total" /tmp/nc.*  | awk "{print \\$1}" | tr "\\n" " " | sed "s/ /ms  /g"\)"
echo "nvim 当前配置\(source vimrc\):    $\(grep -h " total" /tmp/ncfg.* | awk "{print \\$1}" | tr "\\n" " " | sed "s/ /ms  /g"\)"
')

Bash(bash -c '
rm -f /tmp/nc.* /tmp/vc.* /tmp/ncfg.*
for i in 1 2 3; do vim  -u NONE -N --noplugin --startuptime /tmp/vc.$i  +qa >/dev/null 2>&1; done
for i in 1 2 3; do nvim --clean               --startuptime /tmp/nc.$i  +qa >/dev/null 2>&1; done
for i in 1 2 3; do nvim                       --startuptime /tmp/ncfg.$i +qa >/dev/null 2>&1; done
echo "=== 文件末尾几行\(startuptime 最后一行是 total\) ==="
echo "--- vim vc.1 ---"; tail -2 /tmp/vc.1
echo "--- nvim nc.1 ---"; tail -2 /tmp/nc.1
echo "--- nvim cfg ncfg.1 ---"; tail -2 /tmp/ncfg.1
echo
echo "=== 用 awk 取最后一行最后一列 ==="
for tag in vc nc ncfg; do
  vals=""
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    v=$\(awk "END{print \\$NF}" /tmp/$tag.$i 2>/dev/null\)
    vals="$vals $v"
  done
  echo "$tag :$vals"
done
')
